'''Digotto''' was a game played with [[Digit droid]]s. It involved mathematics: the goal was to create the highest, lowest or closest number using the digidroids. The [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] pilot [[Teemto Pagalies/Legends|Teemto Pagalies]] enjoyed playing this game.

*''[[Star Wars Math: Jabba's Game Galaxy]]'' {{1st}}
